name: Henry's Fork (Ashton)
blurb: Choose named floats above Ashton Dam, Ora and Vernon floats ending above Chester Dam, or the separate Chester downstream ramp to Fun Farm float. Dam crossings are not included; older ambiguous itineraries remain under review.

sections.notes: Start at Stone Bridge, below the Warm River confluence, and finish at the Jump Off Canyon ramp on Fishermans Drive. Arrange the shuttle and inspect the takeout before launching.

notices.title: Plan your named takeout
notices.text: These three floats stay above Ashton Dam. Inspect your selected ramp and set the shuttle before starting; a facility marker does not show an exact landing approach.

putInAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
putInAccess.note: IDFG identifies Stone Bridge and a separate Warm River ADA point at nearly the same apron. HFF lower guide, page 8, identifies the boat launch. Preserve one boating-facility identity rather than duplicating the adjacent ADA feature.
putInAccess.directions: Use the designated Stone Bridge launch on the Henrys Fork by the road bridge, below the Warm River confluence. This is a different access from Warm River Campground. Use the launch parking and confirm the ramp before starting.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: IDFG coordinate is on the roadside parking apron, not at the ramp. HFF lower guide, page 11, confirms this named boat access and its one-mile connection to Ashton Reservoir.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the designated Jump Off Canyon river access along Fishermans Drive. Identify the ramp beside the parking apron and arrange a shuttle before launching. This is the upstream alternative to the Ashton Reservoir ramp.

sections.notes: A short connection into the reservoir approach. Take out at the designated Ashton Reservoir recreation-area ramp, well above the dam. Wind and slower reservoir water affect paddling time.

takeOut.name: Vernon Bridge

distanceEvidence.note: Use the local outfitter’s named 2.2-mile reach. The HFF table lists 3.5 miles, inconsistent with its combined Ora-to-Chester distance; an independent USGS river-course trace measures about 2.2 miles using the published Ora ramp approach. Channel and landing connections vary, so this remains approximate.

notices.title: Finish at Vernon Bridge
notices.text: This short reach is below Ashton Dam and ends at Vernon. Chester Dam is farther downstream and requires a separate itinerary and takeout; it is not part of this float.
notices.sourceName: TroutHunter — Ora, Vernon & Chester access guidance

putInAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
putInAccess.note: IDFG confirms active non-motorized boating access but its general point lies across the road from the launch. The HFF lower-river guide, page 23, supplies a ramp-area coordinate that matches the visible access apron below the bridge. Use that source-backed approximate area; no surveyed shoreline fix is claimed.
putInAccess.directions: Use the Ora Bridge ramp downstream of the road bridge, reached through the designated access drive and parking on the south side of the road. This is below Ashton Dam. Set your takeout at Vernon Bridge before launching.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: IDFG and HFF lower guide, page 26, identify Vernon as a boating facility. The agency coordinate lies back from the river in the staging area. Access review does not approve the old Vernon-to-St-Anthony itinerary.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the designated Vernon access and ramp, not an arbitrary point in St. Anthony. Chester Dam is downstream; a trip continuing past it requires separately confirmed takeout, portage and relaunch arrangements.

sections.notes: Finish at the designated ramp above Chester Dam. The lower ramp is a separate launch for another float. Slower backwater and wind can affect the final approach; identify the upper takeout before starting.

notices.title: Launch below Chester Dam
notices.text: Use the separate downstream ramp below the powerhouse. No dam crossing or portage from the upper ramp is included.
notices.sourceName: Henry’s Fork Foundation — Chester Dam access guide

notices.title: Finish at Fun Farm; diversion downstream
notices.text: Take out at the designated facility upstream of the road bridge. A low-head diversion lies downstream; do not treat this itinerary as a continuation through it. Fremont County Search and Rescue reports a rafting rescue below the dam near Fun Farm.
notices.sourceName: Fremont County Search and Rescue — mission reports

putInAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
putInAccess.note: IDFG uses one general facility point for Chester. HFF pages 29–32 identify and illustrate distinct upper and lower ramps. Satellite imagery places this approximate area at the lower apron below the powerhouse; the original agency point is preserved in the binding. No exact landing fix is claimed.
putInAccess.directions: Use the separate launch apron below the Chester Dam powerhouse. Confirm the downstream ramp and your Fun Farm takeout before launching. This itinerary starts below the dam; it does not include a dam crossing or portage from the upstream ramp.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: IDFG — public fishing and boating access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: IDFG currently lists a boating ramp. HFF page 36 identifies the county takeout. The general agency point is in the parking area; this approximate center is at the visible ramp approach. Bridge-replacement imagery is not a current ramp-condition inspection, and the exact shoreline connection remains unverified.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the designated Fun Farm boating takeout upstream of the road bridge. Check the ramp and current signs while setting your shuttle; do not continue to the diversion dam downstream. The bridge has been replaced, so older photographs may look different.

sections.notes: This older itinerary is under review. The named Stone Bridge floats in this guide provide documented boating alternatives above Ashton Dam.
sections.accessReview: Legacy endpoints need correction: Warm River Campground is documented as wading access, and “Ashton (Vernon area)” conflates facilities above and below Ashton Dam. Choose one of the named Stone Bridge, Jump Off Canyon and Ashton Reservoir floats instead.
sections.distanceReview: The old 8-mile value has no unambiguous pair of landings. It is retained only as legacy data and is not used for a trip estimate.

notices.title: Two different access locations
notices.text: Warm River Campground is listed as wading access. Stone Bridge is the separately named boat launch. Ashton Reservoir’s boat ramp lies above Ashton Dam; Vernon is below it.
notices.sourceName: Henry’s Fork Foundation — lower-river access guide
